expected.body: Forgot my password!!! Need to invoice by 5pm. Please just send me a new password to this email.

tickets.reply:
Hi,

Sorry for the stress, let's get you back in quickly. We can't send you a password, but you can reset it yourself:

1. Click "Forgot password" on the login page and enter your email.
2. Open the reset link we email you. It's valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once.

If the email doesn't arrive within 5 minutes, check your spam folder and make sure you're using the email address the account was created with. Requesting a new link invalidates older links.

Kettle staff will never ask you for your password.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

The Kettle support team

expected.subject: Recurring on Growth?
expected.body: There's no 'Make recurring' option under More. Why?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Recurring invoices are only available on the Pro plan, so the 'Make recurring' option won't appear under More on Growth. Pro is R699/month and also includes unlimited users, unlimited invoices, bank sync and API access.

To upgrade, go to Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately, and you're charged a pro-rated amount for the rest of the current month.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

The Kettle support team

expected.subject: Refund my client via Kettle
expected.body: Can you reverse a R3,000 payment my client made by mistake through PayFast?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

Unfortunately Kettle can't reverse client payments, as we don't hold your money. Refunds to your clients are done in your payment provider's dashboard, so you'll need to issue the R3,000 refund from your PayFast dashboard.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

The Kettle support team
